title: Brief traceability register
rule: A status is set only by repository evidence or an official source. 'done' means a file in this repository implements the item. 'partial' means it is implemented with a stated gap. 'missing' means a search of the repository found no implementation. 'blocked' means a source needed to build it does not exist or cannot be reached from this environment.

status_key.done: Implemented and evidenced in this repository.
status_key.partial: Implemented in part; the gap is stated.
status_key.missing: Not found in the repository by search.
status_key.blocked: Cannot be built: the source it needs is not available.

rows.requirement: Report luck as a z-score per team; refuse to publish a strategy that leans on a team outside the noise band.
rows.evidence: scripts/strategies.py now applies the refusal to EVERY strategy in the batch through one function, noise_band_refusal(), after the six existing gates have been evaluated, so the two reasons stay separately visible on the leaderboard. A strategy is REFUSED if any bet it places leans on a team whose luck z-score has |z| >= 1.96 (the two-sided 5% threshold the luck table itself publishes), or on a team with no measurable z-score at all; a totals bet is recorded as leaning on no team rather than treated as safe. Each strategy now carries a noise_band_refusal block (bets checked, bets offending, bets unmeasurable, offending teams with their z, refused true/false) and the block is published as its own table on site/pages/strategies.html. Measured on the current corpus: 11 bets checked, 0 offending, 0 strategies refused — that is the result, not a reason to drop the rule. scripts/test_noise_band_refusal.py proves the rule bites by planting a team at |z| = 1.96 and 2.40 (refused), at -1.96 (refused, band is two-sided), inside the band (not refused), and absent from the table (refused as unmeasurable); it runs inside verify_all.py so the rule cannot be deleted silently. 2026-11-16 by session arena/23b323a3-nba1 (COORDINATION §50) Independently, arena/2042a559-nba1 also reached partial for this row (§50 Q05).
rows.gap: No strategy is refused today because no modelled lean falls outside the band on this corpus. The rule is enforced and demonstrated; its bite is zero on current data.

rows.requirement: Determine correlation values and select strategies that are skill-based rather than luck.
rows.evidence: data/derived/correlations.json and site/pages/correlations.html publish the measured correlation values; site/pages/luck.html publishes a luck z-score for all 30 teams; and, from this session, the skill-versus-luck selection is enforced in code rather than described: strategies.py refuses any strategy leaning on a team outside the luck noise band (see R10), and the six strategy gates already include a bootstrap ROI lower bound (G3) and a stability split (G4). The honest verdict remains that no strategy is validated — the binding constraint is sample size (largest graded set 14 bets against a floor of 100) and the backtest sample is look-ahead contaminated, both of which the leaderboard states. 2026-11-16 by session arena/23b323a3-nba1 (COORDINATION §50) Independently, arena/2042a559-nba1 also reached partial for this row (§50 Q05).
rows.gap: Selecting a genuinely skill-based strategy needs a sample this repository does not yet have. That is a data limitation, not an unimplemented rule.
